## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also list any dependencies that are required for this change.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Optimization / Refactor

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting of this project (`cargo fmt --check`)
- [ ] I have run `cargo check --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`cargo test --workspace`)
- [ ] New and existing unit / integration tests pass locally
- [ ] Documentation ([`SPECIFICATION.md`](SPECIFICATION.md), [`GUIDE.md`](GUIDE.md), or crate READMEs) has been updated if appropriate
